followUps.reason: Reconnect early for 2027. Carol said she will keep Adventure Zone in mind for the future. 2026 blockers were budget and limited remaining space because a kids' craft fair occupies much of the open area. In future outreach, remember that pay-per-play may address budget concerns and the smaller Mini Zone was already mentioned as a possible fit when space is limited. Confirm any pay-per-play guarantee/minimum and percentage with Dave before quoting firm terms.
